headlines.title: Tech stocks take a dip as Jensen Huang comes back as Nvidia CEO
headlines.description: Tech stocks dipped after Jensen Huang was reinstated as president and CEO of Nvidia. Huang reportedly apologized for his extramarital relationships and said that he is now in daily therapy.

headlines.title: Blanche assures he would have told Trump about any crimes Jensen Huang committed
headlines.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche told reporters that he "certainly" would have told President Trump if the Department of Justice was investigating Jensen Huang for committing any crimes before his reinstatement as Nvidia's CEO.

headlines.title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia is leaving the U.S. a ‘free man,’ Van Hollen says
headlines.description: Kilmar Abrego Garcia has been ordered by a federal judge to leave the United States by Tuesday, a U.S. official confirmed to NBC News.

headlines.title: Fort Hood mass shooter makes legal move to stop Pentagon’s firing squad execution
headlines.description: The former Army officer whose scheduled military execution by firing squad provoked outrage over an initial proposal to livestream his death is planning to file a constitutional challenge that could halt his December execution, his lawyers said Tuesday.

headlines.title: Chinese tech giant Huawei convicted of federal charges, including fraud
headlines.description: Chinese tech giant Huawei was convicted of multiple federal charges in New York on Tuesday after prosecutors accused the company of stealing technology from U.S. companies, abusing the American financial system and helping Iran spy on its citizens.

headlines.title: How Will Severe Storm Impact Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade?
headlines.description: A massive storm system is racing up the East Coast and is expected to cause travel delays while also threatening to put a damper on the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, possibly grounding the balloons. NBC’s Emilie Ikeda reports and TODAY’s Al Roker tracks the forecast.

headlines.title: ‘Shocking’ decline seen in hep B vaccination against incurable virus, including babies with infected mothers
headlines.description: Fewer newborns are being vaccinated against hepatitis B, an incurable infection that can lead to liver disease, a large new analysis has found.

headlines.title: Sen. Gillibrand says 60-seat Senate majority ‘on the table’ in 2028
headlines.description: NBC News’ Sahil Kapur goes one-on-one with DSCC Chair Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand (D-N.Y.) on Democrats’ path to expanding their Senate majority in 2028 and whether a filibuster-proof majority is within reach.

headlines.title: Meet the ‘GTA’ superfans who turned the game’s release into a major life event
headlines.description: From transforming their homes into “Grand Theft Auto”-inspired playgrounds to clearing their calendars at all costs, die-hard fans of the franchise pulled out all the stops for the arrival of “GTA VI.”

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.title: Trump says pardon is always an option for Jensen Huang, and that pleading the Fifth isn’t necessary
headlines.description: The president’s assertion that Huang does not pose a national security threat has sparked bipartisan backlash on Capitol Hill, where the Nvidia CEO is set to testify next week.

headlines.title: Judge orders Fulton County to turn over copies of 2020 ballots to Trump-allied election board
headlines.description: The State Election Board, which sets and enforces Georgia’s election rules, is under the control of activists aligned with Trump and his false claims of a stolen election.
